business_rules: Connector exposes an authenticated proxy endpoint that lets approved VConnect integrations retrieve the receipt for a completed mobile offer redemption from Trilogy.
Receipt retrieval is initiated only for a redemption VConnect reports as successfully completed; the proxy never performs the original redemption again.
A returned receipt must belong exactly to the requested property, player, offer, and redemption transaction and carry a stable Receipt ID.
Requests must flow through the approved Trilogy/property integration path; VConnect never connects to Trilogy directly, and Connector does not alter receipt content.

When a receipt has no email/SMS delivery channel, it enters the existing player-receipt ingestion contract (per US 1445168); when email/SMS is requested, the existing distribute-receipt workflow owns ingestion.
The same receipt must never be ingested or stored twice across the proxy and distribution paths; retries are idempotent on redemption transaction + Receipt ID.
Downstream Trilogy failures (timeout, unavailability, validation failure, not-found) are mapped to the approved Connector error format and never reported as a successful receipt.
Property/player authorization is validated before any receipt data is returned; cross-property and cross-player access is rejected; sensitive data is not unnecessarily logged.
functional_requirements: REQ-001 (AC1): Authenticated proxy endpoint accepts authorized VConnect requests identifying property, player, offer, successful redemption transaction, and receipt reference, restricted to enabled tenants/service endpoints.
REQ-002 (AC2): Receipt retrieval requires a successful redemption; failed/incomplete/missing/invalid redemption references are rejected and no second redemption is executed.
REQ-003 (AC3): Correct receipt correlation — returned receipt belongs to requested property/player/offer/redemption with a stable Receipt ID; foreign receipts are never returned.
REQ-004 (AC4): Request is proxied through the approved integration path with correlation identifiers preserved and receipt content unaltered.

REQ-005 (AC5): Successful response returns Receipt ID plus agreed retrieval information, identifies the redemption transaction, and returns URL/status/expiration/display metadata consistent with Loyalty Cloud.

REQ-006 (AC6): Receipts with no email/SMS channel are submitted via the existing player-receipt ingestion contract with complete HTML and required metadata (US 1445168), and ingestion failures are not reported as success.
REQ-007 (AC7): When email/SMS is requested the distribute-receipt workflow owns ingestion; the proxy never creates a duplicate record; retries on the same transaction + Receipt ID are idempotent.
REQ-008 (AC8): One or more legitimate receipts are handled safely — each with its own Receipt ID, never combined, never duplicated as separate receipts.
REQ-009 (AC9): Downstream failures are mapped to the approved error format with safe correlation info and no data leakage; no false success is returned.

REQ-010 (AC10): Property/player authorization is enforced before returning data, sensitive data is not unnecessarily logged, only approved fields are returned, and cross-property/cross-player access is rejected.
non_functional_requirements: Security: authentication/authorization enforcement, tenant enablement, cross-tenant isolation, sensitive-data protection in logs and responses.
Reliability/Recovery: graceful mapping of downstream timeouts/unavailability, idempotent retries, no duplicate ingestion.
Interoperability/API contract: adherence to the agreed Connector/Trilogy contract, correlation-id propagation, response schema and Content-Type consistency.
Data integrity: receipt content unaltered by the proxy; single-ingestion guarantee; consistency with Loyalty Cloud stored record.
dependencies: VConnect successfully completing the original offer redemption and supplying required correlation/reference data.
Existing Trilogy Redeem Offer Receipt capability.
US 1445168 and 1365562 for ingestion and storage of the generated receipt.
constraints: Out of scope: offer list, offer detail, original redemption, mobile UI, receipt-list presentation, receipt HTML rendering, and direct notification delivery.
Distinct from US 1459617 (BeOn post-redemption availability signal/callback).
Endpoint retrieves the receipt after redemption only; it never performs the initial redemption.
assumptions: The proxy endpoint returns JSON (Content-Type: application/json) per the header_validation config.
Approved error format is a structured Connector API error body with a correlation identifier and no sensitive data.
Delivery-channel configuration (email/SMS vs none) is available on the receipt/redemption context to route ingestion vs distribution.
Receipt ID is the stable identifier used for idempotency across retries.

test_conditions.text: Authorized VConnect request from an enabled tenant is accepted and returns the receipt.
Unauthorized application or disabled tenant is rejected.
Only successful redemptions produce a receipt; failed/incomplete/invalid references are rejected and no re-redemption occurs.
Returned receipt matches requested property/player/offer/redemption with a stable Receipt ID; foreign receipts never returned.
Request is proxied through the approved path with correlation IDs preserved and content unaltered.
Successful response contains Receipt ID, retrieval info, transaction reference, and metadata consistent with Loyalty Cloud.
Receipts without email/SMS enter player-receipt ingestion with full HTML/metadata; ingestion failure is not reported as success.
No duplicate ingestion; retries idempotent on transaction + Receipt ID; no second redemption/receipt/URL.
One or more legitimate receipts handled with distinct Receipt IDs, never combined or duplicated.
Downstream failures mapped to approved error format with safe correlation info and no false success or data leakage.
Authorization enforced before returning data; cross-property/cross-player rejected; sensitive data not logged.

test_cases.title: TGO - AC1 Authorized VConnect Request From Enabled Tenant Returns Receipt

test_cases.test_condition: Authorized VConnect request from an enabled tenant is accepted and returns the receipt.
test_cases.preconditions: VConnect integration is an approved/enabled tenant with a valid credential; a successful mobile offer redemption exists with a valid redemption transaction and receipt reference.

steps.action: Send an authenticated request to the Connector proxy receipt-retrieval endpoint with valid property, player, offer, successful redemption transaction, and receipt reference.

steps.expected_result: Endpoint accepts the request and returns HTTP 200 with the correlated receipt (Receipt ID and agreed retrieval information). AND verify response header: Content-Type = application/json

test_cases.title: TGO - AC1 Missing Or Expired Token Is Rejected

exploratory_test_ideas: Concurrent retrievals for the same redemption from multiple VConnect instances to probe idempotency and duplicate-ingestion race conditions.
Replay an old/expired receipt reference to confirm expiration handling and consistency with Loyalty Cloud status.
Tamper with correlation ids mid-flight to confirm they are validated/preserved and not trusted blindly.
Very large receipt HTML payloads to observe truncation, timeout, and logging behavior.
Rapid retries during a simulated Trilogy partial outage to confirm no partial/duplicate ingestion.
Attempt privilege escalation by swapping tenant scope while keeping a valid token to confirm cross-tenant isolation.
